entities.name: Tivan Desert
entities.description: The largest desert on Dominaria, covering most of southeastern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Plane linked by cyclone portals that deposited sand and inhabitants on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who retrieved one of Urza's artifacts from a monument in the desert.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Teferi's friend who left behind devices to help repair the Zhalfirin time rift.

events.summary: Cyclones that were planar portals to Rabiah deposited sand and moved inhabitants to Jamuraa, forming the desert.
events.quote: They also transported many inhabitants from Rabiah to Jamuura

events.summary: Teferi, Niambi, the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch retrieved an artifact orb from a monument in the desert.
events.quote: he retrieved one of these artifacts, a delicate dark crystal orb nestled in a cage of silver vines, from a giant monument in the Tivan Desert

relations.quote: With help from his daughter Niambi
Teferi discovered that his friend Urza had left behind a series of devices
